confirmation.admission: New immutable vintages and causal action/unit compatibility must be checked separately; current interval certification cannot carry forward.
confirmation.early_close: Unsupported extended sessions remain denominator UNAVAILABLE; no calendar compression or RTH substitution.
confirmation.evidence_kind: Untouched future historical cohort, not live/shadow PIT unless separately captured and certified.
confirmation.followup: Up to five further official sessions for final 320-slot labels; not additional entry anchors.
confirmation.selection: First 126 official XNYS sessions after five-session embargo; calendar fixed before outcomes.
confirmation.stopping: One terminal analysis after fixed window and label maturation; no interim significance checks or count-driven extension.
confirmation.warmup: Prior causal prefixes allowed; outcomes from discovery/embargo never train or select parameters.

discovery.dataset_role: Entire existing intraday vintage is discovery; no retrospective holdout.
discovery.warmup: Causal earlier admitted Daily and intraday prefixes are inputs only, not labels or samples.

chronology.purge: No training or optimization. No label spanning the discovery/confirmation boundary may enter confirmation; no cross-partition controls.

comparison.SPY: NOT_REQUIRED_NOT_RUN; no compatible admitted SPY intraday/action vintage. Never substitute Daily/RTH SPY for extended 15m controls. A later SPY study needs separate preregistration.
comparison.baseline_return: B_event_h = arithmetic mean of valid same-slot SOXX control R_h on other sessions.
comparison.control_grid: Latest expected completed atomic 15m inputs with Daily READY/BULLISH, exhaustion READY/NORMAL, H1 raw READY, M15 primitive READY and explicit research FLAT.
comparison.control_identity: Unique symbol/completed15m identity; no polling/correction duplicates. Control vintage/labels obey identical action/unit/horizon rules.
comparison.control_membership: Eligibility fixed from causal state before label access; candidate-bearing other sessions remain eligible controls.
comparison.control_scope: Same partition, same America/New_York completed end slot (including previous-session date at 20:00), hence same premarket/RTH/postmarket segment. Other anchor sessions only.
comparison.control_weight: Equal weight per distinct eligible control session for that slot; all eligible sessions, no outcome-based matching or selection.
comparison.interpretation: Timing selection relative to same-instrument eligible slot cohort, not invested passive NAV, market-neutral alpha or incremental value of each filter.
comparison.omitted_control_gates: H1 ACTIVE, M15 extreme/arm/GC/price/trigger and episode consumption; do not require them for controls.
comparison.primary_metric: Equal-weight mean across candidate anchor sessions of each session's arithmetic mean E_event_64.
comparison.secondary_metrics: Event-weighted mean R_h and E_h, fixed-horizon MFE/MAE and label coverage; descriptive only.

costs.basis: Gross observation marks; commission/spread/slippage cannot be assumed without fills. Zero applied cost is not zero actual trading cost.

decision_scopes.general_spec_roots: Unchanged UNRESOLVED for full strategy/execution profitability; scoped record does not confer require_profitability_ready.

fixed_inputs.scope: Current certified historical interval only; never extend split-free/unit admission to later data.

disposition.alternative: Confirmation population timing excess at primary horizon > 0.
disposition.null_hypothesis: Confirmation population timing excess at primary horizon <= 0.
disposition.pass_authority: Opportunity research only; no profitability/production promotion, trade, risk increase or filter ablation claim.
priority: No candidate events -> ZERO_SIGNAL; metrics/CI null, not zero return and not strategy rejection
Immature required labels -> PENDING; retain events and evaluate later at recorded as_of
Any primary candidate/control label unresolved, missing control support, too few events/dates or invalid bootstrap draw -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
Fully mature/valid confirmation and lower95CI > 0 -> PASS_ENTRY_TIMING_EVIDENCE
Fully mature/valid confirmation and upper95CI < 0 -> REJECT_POSITIVE_ENTRY_TIMING_HYPOTHESIS
Otherwise -> INCONCLUSIVE; failure to reject null is not proof of no effect

execution_admission.empty_current_stream: Execute ZERO_SIGNAL disposition without market/benchmark/outcome reads. No performance evidence or meaningful numeric CI can be produced.
execution_admission.nonempty_future_stream: Requires compatible immutable signal/control traces, outcome/action inputs and exact frozen bootstrap adapter; no provider migration in this action.
execution_admission.preconditions: Verify this committed protocol hash, all dependencies, immutable candidate stream and evaluation manifest before accessing labels; record adapter/source hash, fixed vintage hashes, evaluation_as_of and output identity.
execution_admission.sparse_evidence_routing: Preserve thresholds. After first ZERO_SIGNAL/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE disposition, PM may promote LONG_HISTORY_PROVIDER_AND_VOLUME_EVIDENCE as the blocker to obtaining an informative cohort; no retroactive confirmation claim.

label_contract.actions: Reuse existing v3_cash_action_guard eligibility principles. Unknown action coverage or any dividend/capital gain/split/other unit-changing action in anchor-to-target interval is UNRESOLVED. No reinvestment, dividend return or new action-adjustment engine.
label_contract.anchor: Completed candidate 15m close at event.m15 end_at; must match immutable causal input vintage and event price provenance.
label_contract.clock: Official XNYS sessions, frozen 04:00-20:00 ET profile, 64 expected slots per supported full session; carry across session boundaries/weekends without counting closed time.
label_contract.delayed_input: Signal mark is historical observation; never claim ability to fill at that close. No backdated candidate or queued trigger.
label_contract.dividend_feature_vs_outcome: Feature normalization does not certify outcome action accounting.
label_contract.gaps: Count expected slots, never skip gaps to the h-th available bar; unsupported sessions cause UNAVAILABLE labels spanning them.
label_contract.outcome_known_at: Every target/path/action evidence known_at <= separately frozen evaluation_as_of; never feed future outcome evidence into signal inputs.
label_contract.path: Strictly subsequent slots only; do not use the trigger bar high/low which preceded emission.
label_contract.rationale: One standard extended-session worth of slots is primary; one/four-hour and three/five-session slot horizons are descriptive context, not searched.
label_contract.signal_time: Candidate as_of publication time, not an assumed executable order time.
label_contract.target: Close at the h-th expected completed 15m slot strictly after anchor end_at.
label_contract.units: Finite positive compatible OHLC with valid grid/identity/provenance. No future restatement of anchor or silent vintage mix.

missing_outcomes.aggregate: COMPLETE descriptive paired subset must show total/complete/pending/unresolved denominators and reasons. Never silently discard missing controls or candidates. Any incomplete eligible primary control label blocks inferential primary result.
missing_outcomes.denominator: All immutable candidate events by partition and horizon; all causal eligible controls by slot/session, plus excluded/unavailable-grid reasons.
missing_outcomes.no_signals: Short-circuit before any market-price, action, benchmark or outcome-store read; label counts zero, metrics null.
missing_outcomes.pending: Expected target slot later than evaluation_as_of or fixed vintage endpoint; no fabricated target.
missing_outcomes.secondary: Missing secondary labels do not change primary sample; each horizon reports its own denominator.
missing_outcomes.unresolved: Past expected gap, unsupported session, unit/action uncertainty, future-known label at evaluation_as_of, missing hash, incompatible vintage or insufficient control support.

multiple_testing.historical_search: Prior chart/indicator/discovery exposure is retained; no correction can make that cohort independent confirmation.
multiple_testing.prior_subfamilies: Frozen DLP-B vs DLP-A, blocker D0 vs D1, H1 S0 vs S1 and proposed alternatives retain separate unexecuted subfamily records. This combined-strategy study does not execute/resolve those comparisons or establish filter contributions.
multiple_testing.secondaries: Four other horizons, MFE/MAE and event weighting are descriptive; no secondary p-values or adoption claims.
multiple_testing.trials: Keep ZERO_SIGNAL, failed, rejected and inconclusive reports. A new horizon/baseline/variant/confirmation span requires a new preregistered revision and expanded family accounting before fresh outcomes.

discovery_cases: All fixed historical SOXX data through 2026-10-02 and previous indicator/frequency diagnostics
prior_exposure.interpretation: Signal sparsity was exposed; no entry outcomes were exposed. This is not outcome-blind signal selection.

scope.overlapping_events: Retain all distinct episodes; account for dependence by joint session-block resampling.
scope.purpose: Gross mark-to-mark entry opportunity and timing selection diagnostic.
scope.uniqueness: One event_id and at most one initial event per symbol/H1 episode; collisions fail closed.
unresolved_scope: Actual position open, order timing and fill
Add, reentry, exit, stop, trailing, sizing, overnight and portfolio lifecycle
Execution costs, slippage, after-cost profitability and production promotion
Historical chart parity and live/shadow PIT delivery latency

uncertainty.duplicates: Resampled copies are statistical weights, never new event IDs. Required distinct control support is based on original session identities.
uncertainty.empty_or_invalid_draw: Count and report; if any of 5000 draws has no candidate or insufficient control support, inferential interval and PASS/REJECT are UNAVAILABLE. Never redraw or silently drop replicates.
uncertainty.estimand: Recompute per-event other-original-session same-slot controls in every draw using draw multiplicities, then event excess and equal-draw-session primary mean. Exclude all copies of the event's original session from its controls.
uncertainty.existing_engine_audit: richping.evaluation.block_ci supplies circular block RNG mechanics but averages signal dates and treats comparison rows as fixed. It cannot directly implement this joint calendar/control estimand; a narrowly scoped adapter is required in the later execution action. No new generic evaluation framework.
uncertainty.interval: Two-sided percentile [0.025, 0.975] using numpy.quantile linear interpolation.
uncertainty.limitations: Dependence beyond five anchor sessions and nonstationarity are not eliminated; no IID or calibrated forecast claims.
uncertainty.mechanics: For N anchor sessions, draw ceil(N/5) starts uniformly from 0..N-1 per replicate, append five consecutive session indices modulo N, truncate to N. Retain all candidate/control anchors and labels of each selected session including repeated draws.
uncertainty.method: Joint circular moving-block bootstrap of the full chronological confirmation anchor-session grid.
uncertainty.requirements: At least 30 primary-paired candidate events and 20 distinct candidate anchor sessions; thresholds fixed as evidence floors, not power guarantees.
